name: SAKETH MYNENI
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A big server with an aggressive all-court game, effective in both singles and doubles, particularly strong on hard courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #137 (September 12, 2016), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #74 (January 16, 2023).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the first round of the 2016 US Open (lost to Jiří Veselý).
Notable Achievements: ATP Challenger Titles: Won 3 Challenger singles titles (2014 Indore, 2015 Vietnam, 2016 Pune) and 11 doubles titles. Doubles Success: Won his first ATP Tour doubles title at the 2022 Chennai Open with Ramkumar Ramanathan. Secured a gold medal in men’s doubles at the 2022 Asian Games with Ramanathan and a mixed doubles silver in 2014 with Sania Mirza. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Davis Cup ties since 2014, with a 5-2 singles record and key doubles contributions.
Other Highlights: Overcame multiple injuries, including shoulder surgery in 2017, to maintain a competitive career. Transitioned to a doubles focus in recent years.
Saketh continues to compete actively, balancing Challenger events and representing India internationally. 🎾🇮🇳
